summary: The source-bounded semantic chain remains general rather than fixed Q&A. A current-strength question with verified comparative evidence, and its consecutive ratio or leader references, directly answer from the same controlled source data; no model is asked to reinterpret rankings. A topic/build boundary stops the inheritance. Raider.IO leaders are tie-safe, so a tied top score is never presented as a unique first place. A provider stream has an end-to-end deadline, preventing keepalive-only sessions from running forever. Candidate and production both passed the real three-turn stream smoke in seconds with no sync/backfill start. The full Harness's unrelated UI package stage is blocked by an absent local Taro CLI and is recorded literally. Real WeChat acceptance is still required before merge, push or cleanup.
